GOOD TO KNOW

Small questions.
Clear answers.

Getting to know Rocket Flash? Start here, or send us a message.

How do I start a connection?

Open the Home screen and use the main connection control to turn the VPN on or off. Your connection state, remaining session time and traffic readouts are shown on the same screen.

Can I choose a different country?

Yes. Open Servers to browse the country list and compare the displayed latency and signal indicators, then select a route. Available routes and connection quality may vary.

What can I check inside the app?

Speed shows download, upload and ping measurements. Usage shows recent sessions and a weekly view. Browser lets you search or open site shortcuts without leaving the app.

Where can I read about privacy?

Read our Privacy policy for information about data practices. For privacy questions, contact flayingeast@gmail.com.
